title: Chapter 198 Killing Ilham
content:
Chapter 198 Killing Ilham

Pick up other dropped items.

[Legion Order +5, Energy Crystal +200, Soul Crystal +10]

Wang Shuo was overjoyed when he saw the legion order. He really wanted to give him what he needed!

After leaving the Ministry of Internal Affairs, Wang Shuo planned to go to Huxin Waterside Pavilion to see what opportunities there might be.

Not long after walking, Wang Shuo finally heard the sound of fighting. Could it be the other four people?

When I got closer, I saw four people struggling to deal with an undead leader.

It was Locke and Ye Xueer.

The levels of several of them are also around level 26. It is very difficult to deal with a silver boss with a level as high as 40.

[Tohti Tohti, General Manager of the Dining Hall, Silver Boss]

[Level: Level 40]

[Attack power: 500]

[Defense: 400]

[Health value: 5200]

[Note: Ilham was originally a servant in the dining hall who took care of livestock. Because he was good at making fragrant meat, he was appreciated by the princess and was promoted to the general manager of the dining hall. 】

At this time, Ilham still had half of his health left.

I saw a skeleton on a frame, wearing a pig-killing apron and holding a boning knife in his hand.

Although the movements are clumsy, they are full of explosive power.

Under the charged attack, Locke dodged, and a huge boulder behind him was immediately smashed into pieces by the boning knife.

When the four of them saw the arrival of Wang Shuo and his party, they all secretly became vigilant.

"Do you need help?" Wang Shuo saw that there was only one silver boss and checked the levels of several people. He was not at all afraid and asked relaxedly.

Seeing that several people didn't answer, Wang Shuo said slowly: "If you don't need it, then you continue, I will leave first."

Seeing Wang Shuo turning around to leave, everyone's expressions changed.

At this time, Slitha said: "Wait a minute, since everyone has come to this dungeon, why not join forces?"

Slitha was really fed up with this feeling of being completely suppressed.

If you can find a thigh, you still have to hug him if you can. Although the opponent is more powerful, cooperating with him is not small.

The main reason why Wang Shuo is willing to help is because this boss may drop incomplete reports.

It would be a real pity if you miss it and affect your completion.

"Okay, let's work together!" In order to be wary of a few people, Wang Shuo didn't let all the soldiers join the battle, and he didn't even take action himself.

Only four people, Gong Zheng, Ayub, Bai Liliang and Gu Liji, were sent to join the battle.

First, Gong Zheng and Ayub are enough to show their strength.

Second, he can observe the combat effectiveness of several people, leaving soldiers behind is an invisible deterrent.

Forty soldiers with an average level of 25, standing still, would have a huge deterrent effect on a few people.

With Gong Zheng facing off against the boss's attack, the group of people instantly felt more relaxed.

The boss's health points dropped loudly.

After observing for a while, Wang Shuo judged that the strength of several people was not as strong as his own.

Even if a few people have reservations, they are not that great.

After a few more rounds, the prompt that the boss was killed sounded.

[Your subordinate Ayub killed the silver boss Ilham. 】

When several people saw the exploded items, their eyes lit up and they all wanted to fight for them.

Ayub shouted loudly and swept the green dragon sword ring in a circle, forcing several people back.

"What are you doing?" Huang Maoluoke glared at Ayub.

The other three people also maintained their fighting posture.

Wang Shuo walked over leisurely, not caring about other people's eyes.

"Everyone, I'm sorry, I'm doing a series of tasks and need to collect a task item."

Wang Shuo looked back at a few people and added: "Don't worry, I won't keep the spoils for myself."

"My people are the ones who contribute the most, so I will give priority to picking the spoils. Don't go too far!"
